changelog: New voice command: say 'duplicate last line' or 'repeat last line' (or 'শেষ লাইন ডুপ্লিকেট করো' / 'শেষ লাইন আবার লিখো') alone while dictating and the last line is written again right after itself — handy for repeating a list line, a chorus line or an order row without re-dictating it. Undo removes just the copy, and the clipboard is never touched (74 commands in Help & Support > Voice commands). Nothing else changed — it never sends a message.
